task: Clarified credential architecture for leaps/backend production deployment and confirmed askr's Claude Code OAuth token bypass is working as designed for personal autonomous orchestration; established that leaps cannot reuse askr's session-scoped OAuth grant and must obtain its own funded Console API key for Railway deployment.
discussion_summary: Session 1 built autonomous multi-session infrastructure with structured event logging and quota management. This session investigated whether leaps/backend could reuse askr's Claude Code OAuth credentials for production. After inspecting the actual Keychain credential structure, confirmed that Claude Code stores only a short-lived, session-scoped OAuth access/refresh token pair (expires in ~6 hours, rotates automatically) — not a static Console API key. This token is deliberately scoped to Claude Code client use only and cannot be stably used for a deployed backend service. leaps/backend must obtain its own funded Console API key from console.anthropic.com for production Railway deployment; no technical workaround exists. Estimated leaps' actual inference costs at ~$0.004–0.05 per call (Haiku-dominant, lightweight token budgets), suggesting a modest $10–20 Console top-up is sufficient for testing before production launch.

decisions.decision: Split quota notification into three independent phases (silent poll → user notification → reset wait) instead of a single blocking check
decisions.reason: Users working quickly were being interrupted at 90% threshold instead of real quota edge; silent polling lets them work to the genuine limit before notification

decisions.decision: Persist session_first_seen to disk alongside trigger_state and companioned_sessions
decisions.reason: Prevents grace period reset on daemon restart, enabling accurate idle-trigger dedup across restarts

decisions.decision: Implement per-session scratch handovers with auto-deletion after checkpoint merge
decisions.reason: Prevents accumulation of scratch files and accidental commits of session-local state

decisions.decision: Exempt read-only Bash commands (cat, ls, tail, grep) from cross-repo block guard while maintaining write/edit security
decisions.reason: Allows safe inspection of files across repos without compromising guard integrity for write operations

decisions.decision: Replace raw regex split with shlex tokenization for Bash command parsing
decisions.reason: Honors quoted strings and complex patterns in command arguments, preventing false positives in guard logic

decisions.decision: Raise CONTEXT_TRIGGER from 0.60 to 0.70 and QUOTA_HIGH from 85 to 70
decisions.reason: Aligned thresholds and more runway before companion spawn, reducing false companion triggers

decisions.decision: Fix idle-trigger dedup to key on (project_path, session_id) pair instead of project_path alone
decisions.reason: Multiple stale sessions were clobbering each other's dedup entries; per-session keying prevents false dedup across different sessions

decisions.decision: Truncate task descriptions to one-line summaries in task-held notifications
decisions.reason: Prevents silent Discord 2000-char truncation when multiple verbose tasks are queued

decisions.decision: Skip status:fixed entries from task-held notification count as defensive fix
decisions.reason: Independent of per-task discard API, reduces noise in held-task notices

decisions.decision: Increase Claude Code monthly spend limit to $90
decisions.reason: Ensures sufficient credits for overnight autonomous orchestrator runs without hitting quota mid-execution

decisions.decision: Do not route leaps/backend production LLM calls through askr's Claude Code OAuth token bypass
decisions.reason: leaps is a separate product with its own deployment targets (local + remote via nixpacks); routing through personal Claude Code subscription raises fair-use concerns and creates architectural coupling; leaps/backend must use its own funded Console API key for production

failed_approaches.approach: Attempt to locate a static Console API key hidden within Claude Code's Keychain storage
failed_approaches.reason: Claude Code stores only session-scoped OAuth access/refresh tokens, not Console API keys; the token format and scope explicitly prevent use outside Claude Code client

failed_approaches.approach: Use Claude Code's refreshToken to mint new access tokens for leaps/backend production deployment
failed_approaches.reason: Using Claude Code's own OAuth credentials to authenticate a separate deployed commercial product constitutes impersonation of the Claude Code app outside its intended scope; creates account suspension risk and violates fair-use boundaries
